chapter_seo_title: Han Li Joins a Scattered Cultivator Group at the Tainan Fair
chapter_meta_description: Han Li is invited to join a temporary alliance of independent cultivators. He tests the waters, asks the right questions, and accepts—but only after cold calculation. A chapter of social maneuvering in the dark forest of the cultivation world.
og_title: A Temporary Alliance on Han Li’s Terms
og_description: Daoist Songwen recruits Han Li into a group of scattered cultivators at the Tainan Small Exchange. True to form, Han Li does not join blindly—he demands introductions and clarifies the terms before committing.
twitter_title: Han Li’s First Step into the Cultivation Bazaar
twitter_description: The Tainan Exchange is open for business. Han Li finds a group of friendly cultivators who offer protection in numbers—but his acceptance comes with strings attached: his own terms.
